tools.name: get_projects
tools.title: Retrieve a list of projects
tools.description: List the account's projects with their framework, linked repository, and latest deployment. Use to discover or search for a project; use get_project once its id or name is known.

build_machine_types.description: Filter results by effective build machine types. Accepts comma-separated values. Use "elastic" for projects with elastic selection and "default" for projects without a build machine type set.

build_queue_configuration.description: Filter results by build queue configuration. SKIP_NAMESPACE_QUEUE includes projects without a configuration set.

edge_config_id.description: Filter results by connected Edge Config ID

edge_config_token_id.description: Filter results by connected Edge Config Token ID

elastic_concurrency_enabled.description: Filter results by projects with elastic concurrency enabled

exclude_repos.description: Filter results by excluding those projects that belong to a repo

from.description: Query only projects updated after the given timestamp or continuation token.

git_fork_protection.description: Specifies whether PRs from Git forks should require a team member's authorization before it can be deployed

limit.description: Limit the number of projects returned

repo.description: Filter results by repo. Also used for project count

search.description: Search projects by the name field

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

static_ips_enabled.description: Filter results by projects with Static IPs enabled

team_id.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create a new project
tools.description: Create a new Vercel project that deployments, domains, and environment variables attach to. Use for a project that does not exist yet; use update_project to change the settings of one that does.

build_command.description: The build command for this project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

dev_command.description: The dev command for this project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

enable_affected_projects_deployments.description: Opt-in to skip deployments when there are no changes to the root directory and its dependencies

enable_preview_feedback.description: Opt-in to preview toolbar on the project level

enable_production_feedback.description: Opt-in to production toolbar on the project level

environment_variables.description: Collection of ENV Variables the Project will use

gitBranch.description: If defined, the git branch of the environment variable (must have target=preview)

target.description: Deployment Target or Targets in which the ENV variable will be used

framework.description: The framework that is being used for this project. When `null` is used no framework is selected

git_repository.description: The Git Repository that will be connected to the project. When this is defined, any pushes to the specified connected Git Repository will be automatically deployed

repo.description: The name of the git repository. For example: \"vercel/next.js\"

type.description: The Git Provider of the repository

install_command.description: The install command for this project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

name.description: The desired name for the project

oidc_token_config.description: OpenID Connect JSON Web Token generation configuration.

enabled.description: Whether or not to generate OpenID Connect JSON Web Tokens.

output_directory.description: The output directory of the project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

preview_deployment_suffix.description: Custom domain suffix for preview deployments. Takes precedence over team-level suffix. Must be a domain owned by the team.

preview_deployments_disabled.description: Specifies whether preview deployments are disabled for this project.

public_source.description: Deprecated. Accepted for backwards compatibility but ignored.

resource_config.description: Specifies resource override configuration for the project

functionDefaultRegions.description: The regions to deploy Vercel Functions to for this project

functionZeroConfigFailover.description: Specifies whether Zero Config Failover is enabled for this project.

root_directory.description: The name of a directory or relative path to the source code of your project. When `null` is used it will default to the project root

sandbox.description: Specifies the default region and failover regions for sandboxes created in the project

failoverRegions.description: The regions sandboxes in this project fall back to when they cannot be created in `region`.

region.description: The Vercel region sandboxes in this project are created in by default.

serverless_function_region.description: The region to deploy Serverless Functions in this project

serverless_function_zero_config_failover.description: Specifies whether Zero Config Failover is enabled for this project.

skip_git_connect_during_link.description: Opts-out of the message prompting a CLI user to connect a Git repository in `vercel link`.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

sso_protection.description: The Vercel Auth setting for the project (historically named \"SSO Protection\")

team_id.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

tools.name: get_deployments
tools.title: List deployments
tools.description: List deployments across the account or one project, with the state, target, and commit of each. Use to find recent builds and how they finished; use get_project for a project's configuration rather than its deploy history.

branch.description: Filter deployments based on the branch name

from.description: Gets the deployment created after this Date timestamp. (default: current time)

limit.description: Maximum number of deployments to list from a request.

project_id.description: Filter deployments from the given ID or name.

project_ids.description: Filter deployments from the given project IDs. Cannot be used when projectId is specified.

rollback_candidate.description: Filter deployments based on their rollback candidacy

sha.description: Filter deployments based on the SHA

since.description: Get Deployments created after this JavaScript timestamp.

slug.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

state.description: Filter deployments based on their state (`BUILDING`, `ERROR`, `INITIALIZING`, `QUEUED`, `READY`, `CANCELED`, `BLOCKED`)

target.description: Filter deployments based on the environment.

team_id.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.

to.description: Gets the deployment created before this Date timestamp. (default: current time)

until.description: Get Deployments created before this JavaScript timestamp.

users.description: Filter out deployments based on users who have created the deployment.
